## Project rules - apply to ALL tasks in this repo:
- [constraint] Never include personal fields in the nightly export (id=10544002)
    The nightly export never includes personal fields (name, email, address); finance only needs ids and amounts, and the export bucket is readable by the whole finance org.
- [constraint] Keep secrets in the secrets manager, never in values files (id=1f774595)
    Secrets come from the secrets manager at deploy time and are never committed to values files or the repository, not even encrypted; the pre-commit secret scan blocks obvious leaks.
- [constraint] Add indexes concurrently in production migrations (id=fe8bcc1a)
    Production migrations create indexes with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY; a plain CREATE INDEX on the records table locked writes for eleven minutes.
- [constraint] Never log record ids or function arguments (id=110698ad)
    Never log record ids or function arguments from the record service, because compliance treats request data as customer data; log counts and durations instead.
- [constraint] Use the standard library before any third-party package (id=aace4bb6)
    Use the standard library before any third-party package, and don't add a dependency to pyproject.toml without asking, because each new package needs a licence and security review.
- [constraint] Test every new public function before finishing (id=fd2ac9ef)
    Every new public function in app/ needs at least one test before the change is finished, and run uv run pytest tests/ -q before reporting done, because CI blocks merges on missing tests for new symbols.
- [constraint] Never run database migrations from application start-up (id=d3979369)
    Database migrations never run from application start-up; they run as a separate pre-deploy job, because concurrent replicas racing to migrate corrupted a migration table once.
- [constraint] Read configuration at call time, never at import (id=296ee877)
    Read settings from os.environ inside the function that needs them, never at import time, because the test runner and the worker set variables after import.
- [constraint] Reject request bodies over 1 MiB at the gateway (id=823bf8bf)
    The gateway rejects request bodies larger than 1 MiB with 413 before they reach a service, because one oversized import request exhausted a worker's memory. Bulk imports use the import job's upload bucket instead.
- [constraint] Validate gateway tokens against the identity provider's JWKS, not a shared secret (id=d7290d9f)
    Gateway tokens are verified against the identity provider's published JWKS, never a shared HMAC secret, because a leaked shared secret would let anyone mint tokens for every service.
- [constraint] Rotate production credentials every 90 days (id=877b0b1f)
    Production credentials rotate every 90 days through the secrets manager; long-lived keys in the old vault were found in a laptop backup during the 2025 audit.
- [convention] [suggested] Version gateway routes in the path as /v2/ (id=6ab3191e)
- [convention] [suggested] Name Kubernetes resources service-component (id=44e1fb76)
- [convention] [suggested] Use Conventional Commits (id=286bd9ee)

- [convention] [suggested] Keep one dashboard per service (id=24ab322b)
- [convention] [suggested] Name tables in plural snake_case (id=018fa260)
- [convention] [suggested] Keep user-facing strings in the i18n catalog (id=f5c44497)
- [convention] [suggested] Svc_3 rate tables are versioned by effective date, and a quote records which table version produced… (id=58d5e5fa)
- [convention] [suggested] Record tables in the web app default to 50 rows with a choice of 25, 50 or 100, and remember the ch… (id=25b0d76c)
- [convention] [suggested] Name export files records-YYYYMMDD.csv (id=b033ccb0)
- [convention] [suggested] Run Playwright end-to-end tests against staging nightly (id=ed6e1df9)
- [convention] [suggested] Public functions in app/svc_0_core.py keep a one-line docstring that names the service number. (id=d3d86755)
- [convention] [suggested] Run the full test suite on every pull request (id=e2c084e5)
- [convention] [suggested] Search index documents carry only fields the web app filters or displays; adding a field to the ind… (id=d53e1016)
- [convention] [suggested] An ADR that is replaced is marked superseded with a link to its replacement; ADRs are never deleted… (id=367a9528)
- [convention] [suggested] Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs (id=d3b08526)
- [convention] [suggested] Write user docs in plain English, second person (id=4e8381d8)
- [convention] Run the dependency audit weekly, not per PR (id=87e52054)
- [pattern] Standardise time representation across the record service (id=6c15f2f0)
- [convention] [suggested] Scheduled jobs post a one-line completion message to the ops channel with duration and row counts;… (id=172fff36)
- [convention] [suggested] Format amounts with Intl.NumberFormat in the web app (id=a286034d)
- [convention] [suggested] Use CSS modules, not styled-components, in the web app (id=4726ea44)
- [convention] [suggested] Import template lives in docs/import-template.csv (id=a5b5cd58)
- [convention] [suggested] Label slots like slot-07 (id=48286369)

- [convention] [suggested] Manage dependencies and commands with uv (id=ddb4b98d)
- [convention] [suggested] Tag every cloud resource with team and service (id=83c4a037)
- [convention] [suggested] Open an issue before a large change (id=8706be0f)
- [convention] [suggested] The web app sends the X-Client-Version header on every API call so the gateway can tell which relea… (id=543367c7)
- [convention] [suggested] Web app tests use Testing Library queries by role and label, not CSS selectors, so tests survive st… (id=66a00b30)
- [convention] [suggested] Tenant ids are opaque strings (ten_...) in the API and integers internally; the gateway converts at… (id=10e11813)

- [convention] [suggested] Migration files are named YYYYMMDDHHMM_description.py and are never edited after they reach main; a… (id=955eaad4)
